constraints.definition: CHECK (username::text = btrim(username::text) AND char_length(username::text) >= 3 AND char_length(username::text) <= 50 AND username::text ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'::text)
FOREIGN KEY (deposit_id) REFERENCES deposits(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (showroom_id) REFERENCES showrooms(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying::text, 'DEPOSITED'::character varying::text, 'CANCELLED'::character varying::text, 'REFUNDED'::character varying::text]))
FOREIGN KEY (showroom_id) REFERENCES showrooms(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (source_id) REFERENCES sources(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES app_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (status::text <> 'CONFIRMED'::text OR (transaction_type::text <> ALL (ARRAY['DEPOSIT_RECEIVED'::character varying::text, 'REFUND'::character varying::text])) OR transaction_type::text = 'DEPOSIT_RECEIVED'::text AND amount > 0::numeric AND amount <> 'NaN'::numeric OR transaction_type::text = 'REFUND'::text AND amount < 0::numeric)
FOREIGN KEY (deposit_id) REFERENCES deposits(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (engine_size IS NULL OR engine_size > 0::double precision)

CHECK (fuel_type IS NULL OR (fuel_type::text = ANY (ARRAY['Gasoline'::character varying::text, 'Diesel'::character varying::text, 'Hybrid'::character varying::text, 'Electric'::character varying::text])))
CHECK (origin IS NULL OR (origin::text = ANY (ARRAY['Domestic'::character varying::text, 'Imported'::character varying::text])))
CHECK (seat_count IS NULL OR seat_count >= 2 AND seat_count <= 60)

CHECK (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['ARCHIVED'::character varying::text, 'AVAILABLE'::character varying::text, 'HOLD'::character varying::text, 'RESERVED'::character varying::text, 'SOLD'::character varying::text]))
CHECK (transmission IS NULL OR (transmission::text = ANY (ARRAY['Automatic'::character varying::text, 'Manual'::character varying::text, 'CVT'::character varying::text])))
FOREIGN KEY (showroom_id) REFERENCES showrooms(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
